verdict.rationale: An entity-registry service could plausibly publish a developer API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web forms, PDF-fillable documents and a CAPTCHA-gated filing portal, and probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec at all candidate paths returned 404. There is no evidence of any API reference, interactive or otherwise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
